mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces discount rates applied to expected equity cash flows, increasing the present value of future dividends and earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 5.25% triggers a flight to safety away from equities, compressing discount rates and reducing the present value of future cash flows, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) above 200,000 jobs indicates a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in monthly employment growth (PAYEMS) below 150,000 jobs signals a weakening labor market, which raises uncertainty about corporate earnings and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) above 105 indicates accelerating supply-side growth, which lowers input costs and boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in supply growth periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the Industrial Production index (INDPRO) below 100 signals decelerating supply growth, which raises input costs and compresses discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in deceleration periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in retail sales (HOUST) above 120,000 units indicates strengthening demand, which boosts earnings expectations and lowers discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in retail sales (HOUST) below 110,000 units signals demand weakening, which raises discount rates and compresses earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
